name: qflashlink
description: QQ 闪传分享链接转直链工具，支持本地部署、Cloudflare Workers 与 Cloudflare Pages

scripts.build: npm run build:embedded && npm run build:pages
scripts.dev:pages: npm run build && wrangler pages dev dist
scripts.deploy:pages: npm run build && wrangler pages deploy dist --project-name qflashlink
scripts.check: node --check src/qfile.js && node --check src/handler.js && node --check src/worker.js && node --check src/server.js && node --check public/app.js
